subject: Write up the result, limitations and future work in writing-notes
description:

Include: SHAP rules out month re-encoding; the reproducibility limitation of an external calendar; the non_holiday_days proxy caveat; school holidays out of scope by data availability; weather/macro as future work; the sub-monthly-grain reading of a null. Use the CORRECTED headline: 7/12 helped, mean -1.42pp. The superseded 6/12 and -0.75pp must not appear anywhere in the prose.
